task.title: Using Bluetooth Mode (Audio Inputs)
task.shortdesc: Bluetooth mode allows for easy connectivity through your mobile/electronic device to stream music and use the hands-free calling features through the audio of an FM frequency on your car's radio.

context.p: After setting up the transmitter in your car, you can begin the process of connecting your mobile device to the FM transmitter using the default audio input, Bluetooth Mode.

step.cmd: Go to the Bluetooth settings on your mobile device.

image.alt: "screenshot of Bluetooth settings on moblie device."

step.cmd: Ensure Bluetooth is toggled on and wait for nearby or "other" devices to be scanned by your mobile device.

image.alt: "screenshot of Bluetooth toggle on on mobile device and the scanning of nearby or other devices."

step.cmd: Look for the transmitter's device name "UBCH261" and tap on the name to connect

result.p: The mobile device will show that the transmitter is connected and a sound prompt from the transmitter will also notify that the Bluetooth connection is successful, and you can begin streaming audio from your connected device
